text:
ryan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: two near-identical canary regressions. We need stronger auto-rollback rules, smaller initial blast radius, and explicit owners for follow-ups.

mira: Agree. Can you propose concrete thresholds and owners? Also add a smoke test after each batch.

sam: Proposal: initial batch 0.5% (strict), next batch 3%, then 10%. Auto-rollback triggers: error-rate +5pp over baseline for 3m OR p95 latency +250ms for 2m. Max blast radius enforced at 3% for any canary.

olga: +1. Add schema/malformed-response check to smoke test (fail fast). I'll own alerts mapping (pager for sev2+; slack for sev3).

ryan: I'll draft rollout config and commit a config prototype. Will create INF-5001 tracking card with owners/timeline.

sam: I'll implement rollback rule logic and the smoke test harness. ETA PR: Tue EOD.

mira: I'll own metrics dashboard and runbook doc. ETA for runbook draft: Wed noon.

deploy-bot: Canary plan queued by @ryan: canary-config/2026-04 scheduled 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC.

ryan: INF-5001 created and linked to postmortem. Owners: sam (rollback impl + tests), ryan (config + deploy), mira (alerts + runbook), olga (smoke test validation). Deadlines: tests Tue, infra review Wed, staged rollout Thu.

mira: Also noted repeat pattern: model tokenizer changes and third-party model swaps during rollouts. New pre-rollout checklist item: verify tokenizer/codec compatibility and run model-diff on canary slice.

sam: I'll add circuit-breaker + tag routing so canary traffic is isolated and can't cascade.

olga: Added a short on-call snippet: how to interpret rollback signals, manual override steps, and escalation contacts.

ryan: Created recurring "Rollout Safety Review" monthly calendar invite to revisit thresholds and incident patterns.

mira: Good. Once PRs reference INF-5001 and runbook is in place, we can tighten defaults. For now keep defaults conservative. :thumbsup:
